issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a stack of tickets and you'll win... A water tower!
issues.justification: The rhymed lottery jingle (пачку/водокачку) loses its rhyme and comic doggerel effect; 'water tower' without rhyme is flat.

issues.source_quote: Поскользнулся, упал... Закрытый перелом... Потерял сознание, очнулся - гипс.
issues.translation_quote: Slipped, fell... Closed fracture... Blacked out, woke up — cast.
issues.justification: The refrain is a famous catchphrase; the translation is functional but the 'открытый перелом' punchline (closed vs open fracture, Nadya's joke) is rendered fine. Minor stylistic loss of Soviet officialese.

issues.translation_quote: ice cream fer the kiddies, flowers fer his old lady
issues.justification: Dialect markers ('fer', 'ya', 'ev'rythin'') are inconsistently applied across the gang members and sound like American hick speech, mismatching a Soviet setting.

issues.source_quote: Не виноватая я! Он сам пришёл!
issues.translation_quote: I ain't to blame! He come on his own!
issues.justification: Substandard grammar overdone and register not matching a hotel guest's colloquial Russian.
